svg.title: Inside the busiest port areas, large ships keep to narrow channels; these six areas hold 25% of the busiest route cells

cc:Work.dc:title: Inside the busiest port areas, large ships keep to narrow channels; these six areas hold 25% of the busiest route cells
cc:Work.dc:description: Six close-up maps of port areas showing large-ship route cells shaded by ship count; traffic runs in narrow dredged channels in each.
